2026_02_NO_BAL.headline: New Orleans must crowd Baltimore’s run game without opening explosive lanes
2026_02_NO_BAL.paragraph1: Baltimore enters with Zay Flowers doubtful and multiple offensive linemen carrying questionable tags, increasing the importance of Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry sustaining the ground game. New Orleans can challenge that plan with disciplined early-down run fits, but overcommitting bodies risks giving Jackson space outside structure. Chris Olave remains the Saints’ primary explosive receiving threat, so Baltimore’s coverage must prevent Tyler Shough from finding easy answers when pressure arrives. Protection and tackling in space are the matchup’s central tests.
2026_02_NO_BAL.model_rationale: New Orleans must contain Baltimore’s rushing efficiency without surrendering explosives, while the Ravens need pressure and coverage discipline to keep Shough from extending drives through Olave.
